description: Port of Clippy 0.1.99's unnested_or_patterns: reports a match arm's, let's, if/while let's or parameter's pattern that holds an or-pattern Clippy nests: one with a parenthesised or-pattern among its alternatives, or with two alternatives (adjacent or not) built alike that differ in one sub-pattern at most: `&mut`, the same `x @`, `ref x @` or `mut x @` binding, a tuple, slice or tuple struct (same path) pattern whose differing element is not `..` on either side, among the first six, or a struct pattern (same path, both with or both without `..`, up to six fields in any order) whose other fields are the same, unless the two are the same shorthands only. The lint needs Rust 1.53 (`suppress.clippy.msrv`). Sub-patterns compare by their tokens, parentheses included. Macro arguments and macro_rules! bodies are token trees no syntax-level reader expands; `box` patterns (an unstable feature) do not parse.
